name: bristlecone-guard
description: Deterministic runtime guardrails and M2M safety primitives for autonomous agent pipelines.

tools.name: audit_dns
tools.description: Performs forward DNS resolution and network routing verification for a target domain. Guards against Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF).

tools.name: chunk_text
tools.description: Partitions raw text documents into uniform sliding-window segments with configurable character overlap for vector databases.

tools.name: eval_expression
tools.description: Deterministically evaluates arithmetic, mathematical, and logical expressions inside an AST-isolated sandbox.

tools.name: extract_web
tools.description: Fetches and sanitizes readable text content from public HTTP/HTTPS web pages, stripping boilerplate HTML.

tools.name: repair_json
tools.description: Deterministically parses and repairs malformed, truncated, or unclosed JSON strings produced by LLMs.

tools.name: validate_schema
tools.description: Deterministically validates that a target JSON payload contains all mandatory keys specified in a reference schema.
